name: ideatovideo-engine
description: The render toolchain the app ships with: the HyperFrames engine (the only render engine, DECISIONS 18) and GSAP, pinned, HyperFrames' own shader transitions (the Motion wizard), and three.js (the presets that draw in 3D). Bumping a version is a deliberate step: new lockfile, the phase-2 e2e test, a new release.
